احتجت (form VIII)
# اِحْتَجْتُ (iḥtajtu) /iħ.tad͡ʒ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِحْتَاجَ (iḥtāja)
# اِحْتَجْتَ (iḥtajta) /iħ.tad͡ʒ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْتَاجَ (iḥtāja)
# اِحْتَجْتِ (iḥtajti) /iħ.tad͡ʒ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْتَاجَ (iḥtāja)
# اُحْتِجْتُ (uḥtijtu) /uħ.tid͡ʒ.tu/: first-person singular past passive of اِح
